entries.en: The added mineral can alkalinize the water stored in the tank.
entries.zh: 加入的矿物质能使储水箱中的水变成碱性。

entries.en: The naval officer adjusted his shoulder board before posing for the photograph.
entries.zh: 海军军官在摆姿势拍照前整理了一下肩章。

entries.en: A book seller found the missing volume in a dusty secondhand collection.
entries.zh: 一位书商在一批积满灰尘的二手藏书中找到了缺失的那一卷。

entries.en: The editor cited freedom of the press when challenging the American city's publication ban.
entries.zh: 这位编辑在质疑美国该市的出版禁令时援引了新闻自由。

entries.en: The groom rented a grey morning coat for the formal daytime wedding.
entries.zh: 新郎为正式的日间婚礼租了一件灰色晨礼服。

entries.en: The court asked whether the driver had taken reasonable care near the school crossing.
entries.zh: 法院询问司机在学校过街处附近是否尽到了合理注意义务。

entries.en: The moderator tried to choke off the argument before it disrupted the meeting.
entries.zh: 主持人试图在争论扰乱会议之前将其制止。

entries.en: Moving the spare chairs gave the dancers more elbow room.
entries.zh: 搬走备用椅子给了舞者更大的活动空间。

entries.en: The researchers excluded one alkalinuria record because its sample label was missing.
entries.zh: 研究人员排除了一份碱尿记录，因为其样本标签丢失了。

entries.en: The experiment examined whether the new additive would alkalise the acidic mixture.
entries.zh: 实验考察了新添加剂是否会使这种酸性混合物碱化。

entries.en: Repeated contact with the limestone began to alkalize the water in the model.
entries.zh: 与石灰岩反复接触开始使模型中的水变成碱性。

entries.en: The widower seemed to pine away after losing the companion of his youth.
entries.zh: 失去青年时代的伴侣后，这位鳏夫似乎日渐憔悴消瘦。

entries.en: Cheap rent was attractive, but the flip side was a long daily commute.
entries.zh: 低廉的房租很有吸引力，但另一方面是每天漫长的通勤。

entries.en: Sediment clogged the water filter after repairs to the village supply pipe.
entries.zh: 村里的供水管维修后，泥沙堵塞了滤水器。

entries.en: The memorial preserves the names of prisoners who died in the death camp.
entries.zh: 纪念馆保存着死于这座死亡集中营的囚犯姓名。

entries.en: The dancer relied on muscle sense to repeat the movement with her eyes closed.
entries.zh: 舞者闭着眼睛，依靠肌觉重复这个动作。

entries.en: From the fly bridge, the captain could see beyond the vessel's crowded foredeck.
entries.zh: 船长从驾驶桥楼能看过拥挤的前甲板，望向前方。

entries.en: The shop may be closed; in any case, we should telephone first.
entries.zh: 商店可能关门了；无论如何，我们应该先打电话。

entries.en: The laboratory compared the alkaloidal content of leaves collected at different times.
entries.zh: 实验室比较了不同时期采集的叶片中的生物碱含量。

entries.en: The retrospective study found several alkalosis records with incomplete laboratory data.
entries.zh: 这项回顾性研究发现几份碱中毒记录的实验室数据不完整。

entries.en: The researchers reviewed the alkalotic patient's records before including the case in their analysis.
entries.zh: 研究人员在将该病例纳入分析前，审查了这名碱中毒患者的记录。

entries.en: The ethics seminar compared how hospital policies documented the determination of brain death.
entries.zh: 伦理研讨会比较了医院政策如何记录脑死亡判定。

entries.en: A disabled machine gun stood behind glass in the military history gallery.
entries.zh: 军事历史展厅的玻璃后陈列着一挺已失去功能的机关枪。

entries.en: The survey asked participants how long they had followed a low-fat diet.
entries.zh: 调查询问参与者已经遵循低脂饮食多长时间。

entries.en: Her physical science project examined sound in a crowded concert hall.
entries.zh: 她的物理学项目研究了拥挤音乐厅内的声音。

entries.en: The conductor watched for waiting passengers as the train approached the flag stop.
entries.zh: 火车接近招呼站时，列车员留意着是否有等车的乘客。

entries.en: The biologist recorded bright male plumage as a sex character in the bird population.
entries.zh: 生物学家将雄鸟鲜艳的羽毛记录为这一鸟类种群的性别特征。

entries.en: The novel's black sheep repeatedly gambles away money borrowed from his relatives.
entries.zh: 小说中那个败家子一再把向亲戚借来的钱赌博输光。

entries.en: The archive contained a damaged laboratory sheet documenting alkaluria in the case.
entries.zh: 档案中有一张损坏的实验室记录单，记载了该病例的碱尿情况。

entries.en: The family consented to share its alkaptonuria records with the genetics research team.
entries.zh: 这个家庭同意与遗传学研究团队分享其尿黑酸尿症记录。

entries.en: The referee pointed to the free throw lane after noticing an early step inside.
entries.zh: 裁判发现有人提前踏入罚球区后，指向了那里。

entries.en: Her stiff manner of walking made the heavy costume seem even more awkward.
entries.zh: 她僵硬的步态使沉重的戏服显得更加笨拙。

entries.en: The old club restored its enclosed court so members could play real tennis again.
entries.zh: 这家老俱乐部修复了封闭球场，让会员能再次打室内网球。

entries.en: The illustration enlarged a spider's book lung beside a drawing of its abdomen.
entries.zh: 插图在蜘蛛腹部图旁放大显示了它的书肺。

entries.en: The chairman of the board announced an independent review of the failed merger.
entries.zh: 董事长宣布对失败的合并进行独立审查。

entries.en: The astronomer answered children's questions after her public lecture at the library.
entries.zh: 天文学家在图书馆公开讲演后回答了孩子们的问题。

entries.en: The little dog followed us all the way from the station to the cottage.
entries.zh: 那只小狗从车站一路跟着我们到了小屋。

entries.en: The coach praised her all-around performance in running, jumping, and throwing.
entries.zh: 教练称赞了她在跑、跳和投掷项目中的全面表现。

entries.en: The driver selected low gear before the steep climb out of the valley.
entries.zh: 司机在驶出山谷的陡峭上坡前挂入低速档。

entries.en: The investigation uncovered drug traffic hidden behind a legitimate shipping business.
entries.zh: 调查揭露了藏在合法航运业务背后的毒品交易。

entries.en: A faint equal sign made the handwritten equation difficult to read.
entries.zh: 一个模糊的等号使手写方程难以辨认。

entries.en: The detective tried to ravel out the tangled accounts of the witnesses.
entries.zh: 侦探试图理清证人们纠缠不清的陈述。

entries.en: The engineer compared the modulus of elasticity of the two beam materials.
entries.zh: 工程师比较了两种梁材的弹性模量。

entries.en: The students decided to sit in after the university refused to discuss their demands.
entries.zh: 大学拒绝讨论他们的要求后，学生们决定参加静坐抗议。

entries.en: The committee abandoned its all-embracing proposal and focused on repairing the school roof.
entries.zh: 委员会放弃了那项面面俱到的提案，转而专注于修补学校屋顶。

entries.en: Her all-encompassing history covers village farming, trade, religious life, and migration.
entries.zh: 她那部包罗万象的历史著作涵盖了村庄农业、贸易、宗教生活和移民。

entries.en: He was all-fired eager to see whether the repaired engine would start.
entries.zh: 他极其急切地想看看修好的发动机能否启动。

entries.en: The memorial stands on the site of a former slave market.
entries.zh: 这座纪念碑矗立在一处旧奴隶市场的遗址上。

entries.en: The student corrected her savings calculation after forgetting to include compound interest.
entries.zh: 学生发现漏算复利后，修正了自己的储蓄计算。

entries.en: The property owner agreed to restore the damaged boundary wall.
entries.zh: 业主同意修复损坏的界墙。

entries.en: The patient could sit up long enough to speak to the visitor.
entries.zh: 病人能坐起来，与访客说上一会儿话。

entries.en: The archive contained a notice announcing a change in the central bank's discount rate.
entries.zh: 档案中保存着一份宣布中央银行贴现率调整的通知。

entries.en: The judgment considered whether the landlord had breached a legal duty to the tenant.
entries.zh: 判决考察了房东是否违反了对租客负有的法律义务。

entries.en: She checked the all-important passport before leaving for the airport.
entries.zh: 前往机场前，她检查了那本至关重要的护照。

entries.en: The museum's all-inclusive guide covers its collections, buildings, gardens, and research activities.
entries.zh: 博物馆的综合指南涵盖了其藏品、建筑、花园和研究活动。

entries.en: The legend portrays the old oracle as an all-knowing guide to the king.
entries.zh: 传说将那位年老的神谕者描绘成国王无所不知的向导。

entries.en: The village replaced its ageing sewage system after repeated leaks near the river.
entries.zh: 河边多次发生泄漏后，村庄更换了老化的污水系统。

entries.en: Please sit down beside the window while I bring the documents.
entries.zh: 请在窗边坐下，我去拿文件。

entries.en: Her hen party brought together women who had been friends since school.
entries.zh: 她的女士聚会聚集了一群从学生时代起就是朋友的女性。

entries.en: The simulation showed the wave front bending as it passed through the narrow gap.
entries.zh: 模拟显示，波阵面通过狭窄缝隙时发生了弯曲。

entries.en: The teachers' meeting included a debate about how merit pay should be awarded.
entries.zh: 教师会议讨论了绩效工资应该如何发放。

entries.en: Her environmental science project examined insects living beside polluted streams.
entries.zh: 她的环境科学项目研究了生活在受污染溪流旁的昆虫。

entries.en: The all-metal toolbox survived the fall with only a dent in its lid.
entries.zh: 这个全金属工具箱摔下后仍完好可用，只是盖子凹了一块。

entries.en: We found an all-night café near the station after missing the last train.
entries.zh: 错过末班火车后，我们在车站附近找到了一家通宵咖啡馆。

entries.en: The prison museum removed the hot seat from its public display.
entries.zh: 监狱博物馆将电椅撤出了公开展区。

entries.en: The computer scientist presented a new method for checking distributed programs.
entries.zh: 这位计算机科学家提出了一种检查分布式程序的新方法。

entries.en: His new crew cut made the scar above his ear visible.
entries.zh: 他新剪的平头使耳朵上方的伤疤露了出来。

entries.en: The students measured the field strength at several distances from the coil.
entries.zh: 学生们测量了距线圈不同距离处的场强度。

entries.en: The company negotiated a direct loan with the lender instead of using a broker.
entries.zh: 这家公司直接与贷款方商谈贷款，没有通过经纪人。

entries.en: The poet returned to her native land after thirty years abroad.
entries.zh: 这位诗人在海外度过三十年后回到了祖国。

entries.en: The biologist discarded the faulty sensor after it failed to record the neuron's all-or-none response.
entries.zh: 那个有故障的传感器未能记录神经元全或无的反应，生物学家便弃用了它。

entries.en: The supplier rejected the all-or-nothing offer because partial delivery was the only realistic option.
entries.zh: 供应商拒绝了这项要么全部交货要么不交货的提议，因为部分交货才是唯一现实的选择。

entries.en: The fable gives an all-powerful ruler one weakness that he cannot conceal.
entries.zh: 这则寓言赋予一位无所不能的统治者一个无法掩饰的弱点。

entries.en: The repair should take two hours at the most.
entries.zh: 维修最多应该花两个小时。

entries.en: The official used public contracts to feather his nest before leaving office.
entries.zh: 这名官员在离职前利用公共合同为自己敛财。

entries.en: She was the manager in name, but her assistant made every important decision.
entries.zh: 她名义上是经理，但所有重要决定都由她的助手作出。

entries.en: He opened his pay envelope and noticed that the overtime money was missing.
entries.zh: 他打开工资袋，发现少了加班费。

entries.en: Steam rose from the hot spring as snow settled on the nearby rocks.
entries.zh: 雪落在附近的岩石上时，蒸汽从温泉中升起。

entries.en: The receptionist asked me to spell my last name twice.
entries.zh: 接待员让我把姓拼了两遍。

entries.en: She packed an all-purpose knife for opening parcels and cutting rope.
entries.zh: 她带了一把多用途刀，用来拆包裹和割绳子。

entries.en: The theatre hired an all-round performer who could sing, dance, and juggle.
entries.zh: 剧院聘用了一位能唱歌、跳舞和耍杂技的多才多艺的演员。

entries.en: The newspaper celebrated the all-victorious team after another unbeaten season.
entries.zh: 又一个赛季保持不败后，报纸赞颂了这支全胜的队伍。

entries.en: In the crime novel, the suspect hires someone to bump off his business partner.
entries.zh: 犯罪小说中，嫌疑人雇人谋杀自己的生意伙伴。

entries.en: The prisoner was skin and bones when the doctor first examined him.
entries.zh: 医生第一次为这名囚犯检查时，他已经瘦得皮包骨头。

entries.en: The singer began at a low pitch before rising to the final high note.
entries.zh: 歌手先从低音调唱起，最后升到那个高音。

entries.en: The conductor kept the waltz out of the programme and chose a march in quadruple time.
entries.zh: 指挥没有把那首圆舞曲排进节目，而选了一首四拍子的进行曲。

entries.en: The old invoice listed a charge of one pound sterling for delivery.
entries.zh: 这张旧发票列明了一英镑的配送费。

entries.en: The manager will flip his lid when he sees the ruined display.
entries.zh: 经理看到毁坏的陈列品时，会大发脾气。

entries.en: The diner offered curb service, so we ate without leaving the car.
entries.zh: 这家小餐馆提供路边送餐服务，所以我们没下车就吃上了饭。

entries.en: The new all-weather path kept the school accessible during heavy rain.
entries.zh: 新的全天候小路使学校在大雨期间仍可通行。

entries.en: The embryology slide showed the allantoic membrane beside the developing blood vessels.
entries.zh: 胚胎学切片显示了发育中的血管旁的尿囊膜。

entries.en: The witness kept a low profile after the trial ended.
entries.zh: 审判结束后，证人保持低调。

entries.en: The historian compared military intelligence reports with the commander's later memoir.
entries.zh: 历史学家将军事情报报告与指挥官后来的回忆录作了比较。

entries.en: The small buffer state struggled to remain neutral between its powerful neighbours.
entries.zh: 这个小缓冲国努力在强大的邻国之间保持中立。

entries.en: The archives reveal the negotiations that preceded the nuclear test ban.
entries.zh: 档案揭示了禁止核试验协定达成前的谈判。

entries.en: The historian explained why the old register described her as an illegitimate child.
entries.zh: 历史学家解释了旧登记册为何将她记作非婚生子女。

entries.en: The archive preserved a marriage contract signed before the wedding ceremony.
entries.zh: 档案馆保存着一份在婚礼仪式前签署的婚姻契约。

entries.en: The soldier received compassionate leave when his mother became seriously ill.
entries.zh: 母亲病重后，这名士兵获得了照顾性准假。

entries.en: The conductor shaped the allargando passage with broader gestures and a slowing beat.
entries.zh: 指挥用更开阔的手势和逐渐放慢的节拍处理了渐宽渐慢的乐段。

entries.en: The school cancelled outdoor games because air pollution had worsened overnight.
entries.zh: 由于空气污染一夜之间加重，学校取消了户外游戏。

entries.en: She wanted a court game that could be played indoors during winter.
entries.zh: 她想找一种冬天能在室内球场进行的运动。

entries.en: A crew member had to stand in while the actor changed costumes.
entries.zh: 演员换装时，一名剧组人员不得不代演员站位。

entries.en: The audience began to stand up as the orchestra finished its final piece.
entries.zh: 乐团演奏完最后一首曲子时，观众开始站起来。

entries.en: We stopped beside the stream to take a breather after the steep climb.
entries.zh: 爬完陡坡后，我们在小溪边停下歇口气。

entries.en: The expedition ship changed course to avoid the drifting ice field.
entries.zh: 探险船改变航向，避开那片漂浮的海上冰原。

entries.en: The allegiant guards remained beside the queen after her advisers fled.
entries.zh: 顾问逃走后，忠诚的卫兵仍留在女王身边。

entries.en: The critic read the journey as an allegoric account of moral temptation.
entries.zh: 评论家将这段旅程解读为关于道德诱惑的寓言式叙述。

entries.en: Once she understood the basic principle, the remaining proofs became easier to follow.
entries.zh: 她理解了基本原理后，其余证明就更容易理解了。

entries.en: The exchange reported a higher dollar volume even though fewer shares changed hands.
entries.zh: 交易所报告的美元成交额增加了，尽管转手的股票数量减少了。

entries.en: She paused to dash off a reply before boarding the train.
entries.zh: 她在登上火车前停下来匆匆写了一封回复。

entries.en: My roommate is a night owl who starts serious work after midnight.
entries.zh: 我的室友是个夜猫子，过了午夜才开始认真工作。

entries.en: The newspaper withheld the victim's identity when reporting the sex crime trial.
entries.zh: 报纸在报道这场性犯罪审判时隐去了受害者身份。

entries.en: After retiring from office, he attended the hearing as a private citizen.
entries.zh: 卸任后，他以普通公民的身份出席了听证会。

entries.en: The family was relieved beyond measure when the missing child was found.
entries.zh: 失踪孩子被找到后，这家人感到无比宽慰。

entries.en: The pianist played the opening allegretto, keeping the melody light and moving.
entries.zh: 钢琴家以稍快的速度演奏开头，使旋律轻盈而流动。

entries.en: The genetics team compared allelic frequencies in the two isolated populations.
entries.zh: 遗传学团队比较了两个隔离种群的等位基因频率。

entries.en: The telescope detected a faint white dwarf star near the brighter companion.
entries.zh: 望远镜在较亮的伴星附近探测到了一颗暗淡的白矮星。

entries.en: He lowered the heavy metal music when his neighbour knocked on the wall.
entries.zh: 邻居敲墙时，他把重金属音乐的音量调低了。

entries.en: The court assembled a special jury for the technically complex commercial dispute.
entries.zh: 法院为这起技术上复杂的商业纠纷组成了特别陪审团。

entries.en: The railway museum restored the cabin car that once ended the freight train.
entries.zh: 铁路博物馆修复了那节曾位于货运列车末尾的守车。

entries.en: Another threatening crank call interrupted the shopkeeper's evening meal.
entries.zh: 又一通带有威胁的骚扰电话打断了店主的晚餐。

entries.en: Visitors waited in line outside the closed ticket window.
entries.zh: 访客们在关闭的售票窗口外排队等候。

entries.en: The researcher marked the allelomorphic variants with different colours on the chart.
entries.zh: 研究人员在图表上用不同颜色标出了等位变体。

entries.en: Please line up beside the gate before the coach counts the team.
entries.zh: 请在教练清点队员前到门旁排队。

entries.en: The fire brigade evacuated the entire city block around the damaged warehouse.
entries.zh: 消防队疏散了受损仓库周围的整个街区。

entries.en: Her final pay packet included the holiday wages she was still owed.
entries.zh: 她最后一个工资袋里包括仍欠付的假期工资。

entries.en: A corrupted check character caused the receiver to reject the transmitted data block.
entries.zh: 校验字符损坏导致接收端拒绝了传输的数据块。

entries.en: The miners' archive included compensation records for workers with black lung disease.
entries.zh: 矿工档案中保存了黑肺病工人的赔偿记录。

entries.en: The comedian admitted he would rather jerk off than attend another miserable date.
entries.zh: 那位喜剧演员坦言，他宁愿自慰，也不愿再赴一场糟糕的约会。

entries.en: The driver reported the road rage incident after another motorist smashed his mirror.
entries.zh: 另一名驾车者砸坏他的后视镜后，这位司机报告了这起路怒暴力事件。

entries.en: The medical librarian helped locate older journals devoted to allergology.
entries.zh: 医学图书管理员帮助查找了专门研究过敏学的旧期刊。

entries.en: The historical prescription listed the substance as an alleviant for pain.
entries.zh: 这张历史处方将该物质列为缓解疼痛的药剂。

entries.en: The reviewer noted the alleviative effect of humour in the otherwise sorrowful memoir.
entries.zh: 评论者指出，幽默在这本其他部分充满悲伤的回忆录中起到了舒缓作用。

entries.en: The island's postal service resumed after the ferry returned to its normal schedule.
entries.zh: 渡轮恢复正常班次后，岛上的邮政服务恢复了。

entries.en: Damage to one data track made several files on the disk unreadable.
entries.zh: 一条数据磁轨损坏，使磁盘上的几个文件无法读取。

entries.en: During the coffee break, we shared biscuits and discussed the morning's workshop.
entries.zh: 喝咖啡休息时，我们分吃饼干，讨论上午的研讨活动。

entries.en: She chose bottle green for the curtains instead of the brighter shade.
entries.zh: 她选择深绿色做窗帘，而没有选那个更鲜亮的色调。

entries.en: He moved the garden chair into the shade beneath the apple tree.
entries.zh: 他把园椅搬到了苹果树下的阴凉处。

entries.en: The angler watched his dry fly drift across the surface of the stream.
entries.zh: 垂钓者看着自己的干式假虫饵漂过溪流表面。

entries.en: The basketball game continued after workers replaced the broken scoreboard.
entries.zh: 工作人员更换损坏的记分牌后，篮球赛继续进行。

entries.en: The nineteenth-century handbook described the preparation as an alleviator rather than a cure.
entries.zh: 这本十九世纪手册将该制剂描述为缓解剂，而非治愈药物。

entries.en: The visitor's gentle conversation had an alleviatory effect on the grieving family.
entries.zh: 访客温柔的交谈减轻了这个悲痛家庭的痛苦。

entries.en: An alliaceous smell rose from the pan as the chopped garlic warmed.
entries.zh: 切碎的大蒜受热时，锅里飘出一股葱蒜气味。

entries.en: The stagehand opened a trap door beneath the actor's marked position.
entries.zh: 舞台工作人员在演员的标记位置下方打开了一扇活板门。

entries.en: The parade moved slowly along the town's main drag towards the station.
entries.zh: 游行队伍沿着镇上的主要街道缓缓前往车站。

entries.en: The report examined compensation claims linked to industrial disease in textile factories.
entries.zh: 报告考察了纺织厂中与职业病有关的赔偿申请。

entries.en: Her earliest sense impression of the room was its sharp smell of varnish.
entries.zh: 她对这个房间最初的感官印象是刺鼻的清漆味。

entries.en: The mechanic found that the old car battery could no longer hold a charge.
entries.zh: 机修工发现那块旧汽车蓄电池已经无法蓄电了。

entries.en: The cabinet's alligatored varnish made the once smooth lid look scaly.
entries.zh: 柜子上呈鳄鱼皮纹状皲裂的清漆使原本光滑的盖子看起来像覆着鳞片。

entries.en: The low roof of the ranch house nearly disappeared behind the tall hedge.
entries.zh: 这座低矮平房的屋顶几乎被高树篱完全挡住了。

entries.en: The economics class compared rent changes with movements in the consumer price index.
entries.zh: 经济课上，学生比较了租金变化与消费者物价指数的变动。

entries.en: Parliament appointed a select committee to investigate the failed transport contract.
entries.zh: 议会任命了一个特别委员会，调查这份失败的运输合同。

entries.en: The passenger adjusted the head restraint before the long motorway journey.
entries.zh: 长途高速公路行程开始前，乘客调整了头靠。

entries.en: The actors performed the quarrel in dumb show while the orchestra played.
entries.zh: 乐团演奏时，演员们用哑剧形式表演了那场争吵。

entries.en: The critic called the later period a silver age compared with the preceding golden age of poetry.
entries.zh: 与此前诗歌的黄金时代相比，评论家将后来的时期称为白银时代。

entries.en: The technician inspected the control circuit before testing the amplifier.
entries.zh: 技术员在测试放大器之前检查了控制电路。

entries.en: Only half of the allocable grant remained after the laboratory purchases.
entries.zh: 购置实验室设备后，这笔可分配补助金只剩下一半。

entries.en: The scheduler showed no allocatable memory until two large tasks had finished.
entries.zh: 两个大型任务完成前，调度器显示没有可分配的内存。

entries.en: The team could not place the two allochronic taxa together in its reconstruction of the ancient reef.
entries.zh: 团队无法在对古代礁群的复原中将这两个生存年代不重叠的分类群放在一起。

entries.en: The technician waited inside the air lock before entering the pressurised chamber.
entries.zh: 技术员在气闸室内等候，然后进入加压舱。

entries.en: The student searched older case law for decisions involving similar contract language.
entries.zh: 学生查阅了较早的判例法，寻找涉及类似合同措辞的裁决。

entries.en: The unit investment trust sent holders a report listing changes in its securities portfolio.
entries.zh: 这家单位投资信托公司向持有人发送了一份报告，列明其证券投资组合的变化。

entries.en: The old bakery was converted into a dwelling house for a local family.
entries.zh: 这家旧面包店被改造成了一户当地家庭的住宅。

entries.en: The superior general visited the order's schools during her regional tour.
entries.zh: 修道会总会长在地区巡访期间访问了该修道会的学校。

entries.en: The anthropologist recorded how the kin group shared work during the harvest.
entries.zh: 人类学家记录了这个亲族群体在收获期间如何分担工作。

entries.en: The geologist traced the allochthonous boulder to a granite outcrop twenty kilometres upstream.
entries.zh: 地质学家将这块移来的巨石追溯到上游二十公里处的花岗岩露头。

entries.en: The bishop's allocution urged the congregation to support families displaced by flooding.
entries.zh: 主教的训谕敦促会众帮助因洪水而流离失所的家庭。

entries.en: The botanist compared seed production in allogamous plants grown at different distances apart.
entries.zh: 植物学家比较了以不同间距种植的异花受粉植物的结籽情况。

entries.en: The art dealer asked a specialist to examine the painting's disputed signature.
entries.zh: 画商请一位专家检查画作上有争议的签名。

entries.en: The linguist tested the proposed sound law against newly discovered medieval spellings.
entries.zh: 语言学家用新发现的中世纪拼写形式检验了提出的语音定律。

entries.en: The chemical plant suspended production while inspectors examined a damaged storage tank.
entries.zh: 检查员检查受损储罐期间，这家化工厂暂停了生产。

entries.en: A faded sign marked the city limit beside the old highway.
entries.zh: 旧公路旁一块褪色的标牌标示着城市边界。

entries.en: The fairy tale's healer uses white magic to protect the village from harm.
entries.zh: 童话中的治疗者运用善意的法术，保护村庄免受伤害。

entries.en: The ward clerk logged the telephone order and noted which doctor had called.
entries.zh: 病房文员记录了电话医嘱，并注明是哪位医生打来的。

entries.en: The architect's professional relation with the client ended when the final drawings were delivered.
entries.zh: 建筑师交付最后的图纸后，与客户的业务关系便结束了。
